hindi: बालक, वृद्ध, क्षत, क्षीण और सुकुमार मनुष्य में।
english: In a child, an old person, one wounded, one wasted, and a delicate person,
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 74 (previous chunk). Syntax: the locatives of this unit are governed by 'yojyaḥ' ('is to be used') in unit 76; the pairing of lines into verses is a guess and is not given by the printed marks.
lines_deva: बाले वृद्धे क्षते क्षीणे सुकुमारे च मानवे
lines_iast: bāle vṛddhe kṣate kṣīṇe sukumāre ca mānave

hindi: चतुरंगुल यानी अमलतास का प्रयोग करना चाहिए, विशेषकर इसलिए कि पीने में वह मृदु है।
english: Caturaṃgula (lit. 'four-finger'; Indian laburnum) is to be used, especially because it is mild when drunk.

text_flags.why: possible: the token has 15 syllables where 16 are needed (a 'vi' seems lost before śeṣāt); 'mṛdan' is doubtful (possibly mṛdu); 'pāyitvāt' itself is unusual

notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 77. Reading of the second word is doubtful (see text_flags); the reason clause is reconstructed. Caturaṃgula is kept as a name. Syntax: 'yojyaḥ' ('is to be used') completes the locatives of unit 75 ('in a child, an old person ...'). Identification: caturaṃgula = āragvadha, Cassia fistula (Indian laburnum, amaltas); tag: standard. Unit left otherwise as reviewed (low confidence).

hindi: फल लगने के समय उसके पके हुए फल को एकत्र करना चाहिए।
english: At fruiting time one should gather its ripened fruit.
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 76.

hindi: उनमें से जो गुणवान् हैं, उनके भार को बालू में रखना चाहिए।
english: Of those that have good qualities, one should put the load into sands.
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 79. 'teṣām' (gen. pl., masculine or neuter alike); the text does not name what it refers to (presumably the gathered fruits of the previous unit).

hindi: समान रात्रियों, पाठ संदिग्ध है, के बाद उन्हें निकालकर फिर धूप में सुखाना चाहिए।
english: After 'equal nights' (reading doubtful), having taken them out, one should then dry them in the sun.

text_flags.why: possible: 'sama-rātra' (equal nights) gives no clear sense; a number of nights (e.g. 'seven') may have been meant. Printed form kept in words

notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 78. 'samarātrāt' is kept as printed and rendered literally; the sense is doubtful. 'ātape' can also mean 'heat'.

hindi: फिर मज्जा को निकालकर स्वच्छ पात्र में रखना चाहिए।
english: Then, having taken out the kernel (majjā), one should place it in a clean vessel.
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 81. 'tato' is tataḥ before a voiced sound. 'nidhāpayet' is a causative form (lit. 'should cause to be placed').

words.gloss: with drākṣā juice (grape, Vitis vinifera; standard)

hindi: द्राक्षा यानी अंगूर के रस के साथ उसे दाह यानी जलन और उदावर्त से पीड़ित को देना चाहिए।
english: One should give it, with drākṣā (grape) juice, to one afflicted by burning and udāvarta (lit. 'upward turning').
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 80. Printed spelling 'udāvartta' (double t) is a variant spelling of udāvarta. 'rasa' taken as 'juice'. Drug name drākṣā kept. drākṣā = grape, Vitis vinifera (standard); the text does not say fresh or dried fruit. Enrichment gap filled: dāha = burning sensation; udāvarta = disorder in which Vāta moves upward or is obstructed, with retention of stool, urine and flatus and abdominal distension (standard description).

hindi: चार वर्ष के बालक में सुखपूर्वक, बारह वर्ष की आयु तक।
english: Comfortably in a child of four years, up to one of twelve years.
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 83. 'sukham' could also be read as 'easy, pleasant (as a predicate)'; the verb is not stated.

hindi: अथवा चतुरंगुल यानी अमलतास की मज्जा; ठंडा काढ़ा पिलाना चाहिए।
english: Or the kernel (majjā) of caturaṃgula (Indian laburnum); one should make (him) drink a cold decoction.
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 82. Construction is loose: 'majjaḥ' (nom.) stands without a verb next to 'kaṣāyaṃ pāyayet'; read as the kernel preparation (decoction) of caturaṃgula. 'pāyayet' = 'should make (him) drink' (OPEN glossary item, plainest literal wording).

words.gloss: curd maṇḍa, surā maṇḍa, dhātrī-fruit juices (dhātrī = āmalakī, emblic myrobalan, Phyllanthus emblica; standard)

hindi: दही के मण्ड, सुरा के मण्ड और धात्रीफल यानी आँवले के रस के साथ, अलग-अलग।
english: Separately, with the maṇḍa (clear upper part) of curd, the maṇḍa of surā, and the juices of dhātrī fruit.

text_flags.why: stray '~' in the printed token (from a chandrabindu in the scan); no letter is missing

notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 85. 'rasaiḥ' (juices) may attach only to dhātrī-phala or to all three items; rendered as three separate items. dhātrī = āmalakī, Phyllanthus emblica (emblic myrobalan, Hindi āṃvlā); tag: standard.

words.gloss: with sauvīraka (a sour fermented barley drink; probable)

hindi: अथवा सौवीरक यानी खट्टे किण्वित यव-पेय से मिलाकर, या त्रिवृत् यानी निसोथ के कल्क से मिलाकर।
english: Or mixed with sauvīraka, or with a paste (kalka) of trivṛt.
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 84. 'traivṛta' = 'relating to trivṛt' (a drug name; identified below); the case of 'yuktaṃ' is taken as agreeing with 'kaṣāyaṃ' of the previous unit. Identifications: sauvīraka = a sour fermented drink made from barley (probable; its exact preparation is not given here); trivṛt = Operculina turpethum (turpeth, Hindi nisoth), standard.
lines_deva: सौवीरकेण वा युक्तं कल्केन त्रैवृतेन वा
lines_iast: sauvīrakeṇa vā yuktaṃ kalkena traivṛtena vā

hindi: अथवा चतुरंगुल यानी अमलतास के साथ पकाए गए दूध से जो घी उत्पन्न हो।
english: Or the ghee that would arise from milk cooked with caturaṃgula (Indian laburnum).
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 87.

words.gloss: with a paste of the kernel
of the dhātrīs (āmalakī fruits; see unit 84)

hindi: उसे मज्जा के कल्क के साथ धात्रियों यानी आँवलों के रस में पकाकर पीना चाहिए।
english: One should drink that (ghee), cooked with a paste of the kernel (majjā) in the juice of dhātrīs.
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 86. 'tat' is taken to refer to the ghee of the previous unit. 'majja' here is the kernel (majjā).

words.gloss: of kulatthas (horse gram, Macrotyloma uniflorum; standard)

hindi: वही दशमूल का, कुलत्थों यानी कुलथी का और यव यानी जौ का।
english: The same, of the ten roots (daśamūla), of kulatthas, and of barley,
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 89. The genitives depend on 'kaṣāye' (in the decoction) in the next unit. Kulattha kept as a name; yava taken as barley. daśamūla, the "ten roots": standard members are bilva, agnimantha, śyonāka, pāṭalā, gambhārī (the "greater five"), and śālaparṇī, pṛśniparṇī, bṛhatī, kaṇṭakārī, gokṣura (the "lesser five"). The text here does not list them; this is the standard group.

words.gloss: with śyāmā (disputed: commonly black trivṛt, Operculina turpethum) and others

hindi: काढ़े में पकाया हुआ घी श्यामा आदि के कल्कों के साथ पीना चाहिए।
english: One should drink ghee cooked in the decoction, with pastes of śyāmā and the rest.
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 88. Syntax: 'kaṣāye' is read with the genitives of unit 88 ('in the decoction of daśamūla, of kulattha and of yava'); 'tad eva' ('that same') is taken as the preceding procedure. śyāmā: tag disputed; most often taken as the black (śyāmā) variety of trivṛt, Operculina turpethum, but the word is used for several plants. "And the rest" (ādi) is not enumerated in this unit.
lines_deva: कषाये साधितं सर्पिः कल्कैः श्यामादिभिः पिबेत्
lines_iast: kaṣāye sādhitaṃ sarpiḥ kalkaiḥ śyāmādibhiḥ pibet

words.gloss: in the decoction of daṃtī (Baliospermum montanum; probable)

hindi: दंती के काढ़े में उसकी मज्जा और पुराना गुड़ डालना चाहिए।
english: Into the decoction of daṃtī one should put its kernel (majjā) and old guḍa (unrefined sugar).
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 91. daṃtī = Baliospermum montanum (the plant called wild croton); tag: probable (some authors take Croton polyandrum for dantī or dravantī).
lines_deva: दंतीकषाये तन्मज्जां गुडं जीर्णं च निक्षिपेत्
lines_iast: daṃtīkaṣāye tanmajjāṃ guḍaṃ jīrṇaṃ ca nikṣipet

hindi: उस अरिष्ट को एक मास तक रखा हुआ, अथवा केवल एक पक्ष तक रखा हुआ, पिलाना चाहिए।
english: One should make (him) drink that ariṣṭa, kept for a month, or for just a fortnight.

text_flags.why: possible: m + a gives no long ā; 'tam ariṣṭaṃ' expected

notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 90. 'ariṣṭa' kept as a preparation name.

words.gloss: of the root of tilvaka (disputed; often Symplocos racemosa, also Ventilago species)

hindi: तिल्वक की जड़ की त्वचा को, भीतरी वल्कल को छोड़कर,
english: The skin (bark) of the root of tilvaka, having discarded the inner bark,
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 93. tilvaka: tag disputed. Texts and later writers variously give Symplocos racemosa (also called lodhra) or Ventilago species; no firm identification is claimed here. The root bark is meant (tvac, with the inner bark discarded). Note: unit 94 uses rodhra (lodhra) as a separate drug in the same recipe, so the text does not treat tilvaka as lodhra; the Ventilago option is a later opinion not checked here.

hindi: सुखाकर और चूर्ण बनाकर फिर दो भागों को छानना चाहिए।
english: Having dried it and powdered it, one should then strain two parts.

text_flags.why: metre: 15 syllables, 16 needed; the absolutive of cūrṇ is cūrṇayitvā

notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 92. 'gālayet' (caus. of √gal, 'flow/drip') taken as 'strain, sift'; the third part is dealt with in the next unit.
lines_deva: विशोष्य चूर्ण्यित्वा च द्वौ भागौ गालयेत्ततः
lines_iast: viśoṣya cūrṇyitvā ca dvau bhāgau gālayettataḥ

hindi: रोध्र यानी लोध के ही काढ़े से तीसरे भाग को उसी से भिगोना चाहिए।
english: With the decoction of rodhra alone, the third (part) one should saturate with it.
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 95. 'bhāvayet' (lit. 'cause to become') rendered 'saturate' (soak, steep); 'tṛtīyam' is taken as 'third part' after 'two parts' in the previous unit. rodhra = lodhra, Symplocos racemosa; tag: standard.

hindi: दशमूल यानी दस जड़ों के काढ़े में उस भिगोए हुए भाग को फिर भिगोना चाहिए।
english: In the decoction of the ten roots (one should saturate) that part, already saturated, once more.
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 94. The verb is not stated; 'bhāvayet' is supplied from the previous unit.
lines_deva: कषाये दशमूलस्य तं भागं भावितं पुनः
lines_iast: kaṣāye daśamūlasya taṃ bhāgaṃ bhāvitaṃ punaḥ

hindi: फिर सूखा चूर्ण बनाकर, तब हथेली भर पीना चाहिए।
english: Having then made it a dry powder, one should then drink a palmful (lit. 'palm-surface').
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 97. 'pāṇitalam' = palm-surface; understood as a palm-sized measure.
lines_deva: शुष्कचूर्णं ततः कृत्वा ततः पाणितलं पिबेत्
lines_iast: śuṣkacūrṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā tataḥ pāṇitalaṃ pibet

words.gloss: mastu (whey, the watery part of curd)

hindi: मस्तु यानी दही का पानी, मूत्र, सुरामंड, कोल यानी बेर, धात्रीफल यानी आँवला और जल के साथ।
english: With mastu, urine, surā-maṇḍa, kola, dhātrī fruit, and water.
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 96. Parsing of the dvandva is ambiguous: 'aṃbubhiḥ' may qualify only kola and dhātrī-phala ('waters of kola and dhātrī fruit'). Rendered as a plain list. mastu = whey (water separated from curd); kola = jujube, Ziziphus jujuba, tag: probable. The animal source of mūtra (urine) is not stated in the text.

words.gloss: abhayā (harītakī, chebulic myrobalan, Terminalia chebula; standard)

hindi: मेषशृंगी यानी मेढ़ासिंगी, अभया यानी हरड़, कृष्णा यानी पीपर और चित्रक यानी चीता के साथ उबाले गए जल में,
english: In water boiled with meṣaśṛṃgī (probably Gymnema sylvestre), abhayā (chebulic myrobalan), kṛṣṇā (long pepper) and citraka (leadwort),
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 99. Drug names kept. Identifications: meṣaśṛṃgī = Gymnema sylvestre, probable (Dolichandrone falcata is also proposed); abhayā = harītakī, Terminalia chebula, standard; kṛṣṇā = pippalī, Piper longum, standard in this context (the word has other senses); citraka = Plumbago zeylanica, standard.

hindi: मैरुजों, पाठ अस्पष्ट है, को निचोड़ना चाहिए, और जब वह सौवीरक बन जाए,
english: One should press out the mairujas (reading doubtful), and when that has become sauvīraka,

text_flags.why: possible: the word 'mairuja' is not clear to me; maireya is a known word for a drink, but this cannot be confirmed; printed form kept in words

notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 98. 'mairujān' unclear; 'sunuyāt' (opt. of √su) taken as 'press out, extract'. Translation of this half-verse is tentative.

hindi: उसका अंजलि भर हो; तब रोध्र का कल्क पीना चाहिए।
english: Let it be (taken) by a cupped-hands measure of it; then one should drink the paste (kalka) of rodhra.

text_flags.why: bhavet + aṃjalinā gives 'bhaved aṃjalinā'; printed 'r' for 'd' is a misprint

notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 101. Sense of 'bhavet ... aṃjalinā tasya' is uncertain; read as 'a cupped-hands measure of it'.

hindi: रोध्र यानी लोध के काढ़े से उत्पन्न, पक्ष भर रखी हुई सुरा पीनी चाहिए।
english: One should drink surā produced with a decoction of rodhra and kept for a fortnight.
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 100.

hindi: तिल्वक के काढ़े और कल्क से तथा शर्करा यानी चीनी सहित,
english: With the decoction and the paste of tilvaka, and with śarkarā (sugar),
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 103. 'śarkarā' = sugar (alternatively grit/gravel); continues into the next unit (the leha).

hindi: घी सहित पकाया हुआ लेह; और वह उत्तम विरेचन यानी दस्त लाने वाला उपाय है।
english: A leha cooked with ghee; and that is an excellent purgation (virecana).
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 102. 'saḥ' (m.) with neuter 'śreṣṭhaṃ virecanaṃ': gender mismatch left as printed. virecana = purgation (induced evacuation by the bowel). leha = an electuary, a thick medicated paste that is licked (standard).
lines_deva: सघृतः साधितो लेहः स च श्रेष्ठं विरेचनं
lines_iast: saghṛtaḥ sādhito lehaḥ sa ca śreṣṭhaṃ virecanaṃ

words.gloss: sudhā (Euphorbia, spurge; disputed between Euphorbia neriifolia and E. nivulia)

hindi: सुधा यानी थूहर दोषों के बड़े संचय को भी भेद देती है।
english: Sudhā (spurge, Euphorbia; see note) splits even a great accumulation of the doṣas.
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 105. 'sudhā' kept as a name. sudhā = snuhī, a spiny milky Euphorbia (Euphorbia neriifolia / E. nivulia; the species is disputed, the genus probable). Units 109 and 111 (thorns, milk) fit this plant but do not name it.

hindi: शीघ्र ही कष्टदायक हानि के कारण उसे तब कदापि प्रयुक्त नहीं करना चाहिए।
english: Because of the painful ruin that comes quickly, one should not at all employ it then

text_flags.why: possible: ablative -āt before 'na' gives -ān na; the extra anusvāra in '-āṃnn-' looks like a misprint

notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 104. 'tāṃ' = sudhā (f.). 'kalpayet' rendered 'employ'; 'tataḥ' could also be 'therefore'. The negation governs the locatives of the next unit (soft koṣṭha etc.). Sense of 'kaṣṭa-vibhraṃśa' is uncertain.

hindi: मृदु कोष्ठ वाले में, दुर्बल में, बालक में, वृद्ध में, और दीर्घकाल के रोगी में।
english: In one with a soft koṣṭha, in a weak one, in a child, in an old person, in one long diseased,
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 107. 'mṛdau koṣṭhe' read as 'in a soft koṣṭha' (lit. 'storehouse'), i.e. in one whose koṣṭha is soft. The 'not' of the previous unit carries over. Unit 107 turns to cases where it is employed ('kalpyā'), so the negation of 105 covers only this unit's locatives.

hindi: गुल्म, उदर, अस्पष्ट पाठ, और मधुमेह वालों में इसका प्रयोग करना चाहिए।
english: It is to be employed in those with gulma (abdominal lump), udara ('belly'), 'gatvroga' (damaged), and madhumeha ('honey-urine', the urinary disorder usually identified with diabetes mellitus).

text_flags.why: damaged: 'gatvroga' is unintelligible; the line has 14 syllables where 16 are needed, so two syllables are lost

notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 106. The word 'gatvroga' is damaged and not translated; Hindi marks it as unclear. Hindi keeps the Sanskrit terms gulma, udara, madhumeha as names (the old restriction against modern disease names is lifted by the owner; see the next note). Syntax: 'kalpyā' ('is to be employed') is positive and turns from the negative statement of units 105-106. Unverified guess for the damaged word: a transposition of the printed letters would give 'tvag-roga' (skin ailment), but two syllables are still missing, so it is not used. Enrichment: gulma = abdominal lump (standard); udara = belly (the text names it as a condition: abdominal disease, standard); madhumeha = the urinary disorder of the prameha group, usually identified with diabetes mellitus (probable). Only these clear words were enriched; the damaged word gatvroga and its reading are untouched.

words.gloss: in pāṇḍu ('pale', the condition; roughly anaemia with pallor, probable)
in dūṣī-poison (dūṣīviṣa, residual or weakened poison lodged in the body)
in one whose mind is bewildered by doṣas

hindi: पाण्डु यानी रक्ताल्पता जैसे फीकेपन के रोग में, दूषीविष यानी शरीर में टिके हल्के विष में, सूजन में, और दोषों से भ्रान्तचित्त में।
english: In pāṇḍu ('pale', the condition, roughly anaemia), in dūṣīviṣa (residual poison lodged in the body), in swelling, and in one whose mind is bewildered by the doṣas.
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 109. Continues the list of conditions begun in unit 107; 'dūṣīviṣa' kept as a technical name. Identifications: pāṇḍu = the disease marked by pallor, roughly anaemia (probable; it may also include other pale-making conditions); dūṣīviṣa = residual or weakened poison that stays in the body and acts slowly (standard concept in Sanskrit medicine); śopha = swelling (oedema).

hindi: वह श्रेष्ठ है, तीखे और बहुत-से काँटों से ढकी हुई।
english: That one is best, covered with sharp and many thorns.
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 108. 'sā' is taken as sudhā (f.) of unit 104.

hindi: दो वर्ष की या तीन वर्ष की, विशेषकर शिशिर ऋतु के अंत में।
english: Two years old or three years old, and especially at the end of the cold season (śiśira).

text_flags.why: two tokens are a misprint for the single word śiśira-ante > śiśirānte; stray anusvāra

notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 111. Because the printed tokens split 'śiśirānte', the words 'śiśira' and 'ante' are placed on the two printed tokens.
lines_deva: द्विवर्षा वा त्रिवर्षा वा शिशिरां ते विशेषतः
lines_iast: dvivarṣā vā trivarṣā vā śiśirāṃ te viśeṣataḥ

hindi: उसे शस्त्र से चीरकर फिर दूध निकालना चाहिए।
english: Having split it open with a blade, one should then draw out the milk (kṣīra).
notes: GROUPING: one half-verse line of the edition; it forms one verse with unit 110. 'śastra' rendered 'blade' (instrument). Interpretation (probable, not stated in the text): kṣīra, "milk", is here the milky sap (latex) of the plant, which fits sudhā (a milky Euphorbia) of unit 104; the translation keeps "milk".
